items.title: CVE-2026-111357: Ivanti Connect Secure local privilege escalation to root in dsinvoked broker (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Ivanti Connect Secure has a flaw in how its dsinvoked broker trusts DSCache configuration data, which lets an attacker who already has code execution as the cgi-server user escalate to root and run commands as root on the appliance. The attacker must have local access and a low-privilege login, public exploit code exists, and CISA lists the flaw as actively exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-87902: WordPress remote code execution in page template resolution (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. WordPress has a flaw in how it picks a page template, which lets an attacker make the site load a chosen readable PHP file from outside the theme folders. It can be reached remotely without logging in and can lead to remote code execution when certain server and theme conditions are met, and it is listed as being exploited in attacks, with public exploit code available.

items.title: CVE-2026-59309: VMware authentication bypass in VMware Directory Service (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. VMware vCenter, which is also part of products such as Cloud Foundation, vSphere Foundation, Telco Cloud Infrastructure and Telco Cloud Platform, has a flaw in its VMware Directory Service that lets an attacker bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in, and public exploit code is available.

items.title: CVE-2026-132660: EnterpriseDB Postgres Enterprise Manager remote code execution via SECURITY DEFINER search path (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. EnterpriseDB's Postgres Enterprise Manager has several privileged database functions that don't use a safe search path, so a user who can connect to its backend database can plant objects that the functions use in their place. Over the network with only a low-privilege login and no user interaction, an attacker can use this to run arbitrary SQL with superuser privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-134624: N-able MailAssure server-side request forgery in relay LDAP sync check (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. N-able MailAssure's relay LDAP synchronisation connection check does not restrict its destination, which enables a server-side request forgery flaw. items.title: CVE-2026-118527: Ivanti Connect Secure authenticated remote file upload via predictable filenames (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Ivanti Connect Secure has a flaw that lets an attacker who is logged in with a low-privilege account upload files with content they control to a known location on the device's disk, reaching it remotely over the network with no user interaction needed. It can be chained with other vulnerabilities, public exploit code is available, and attacks using it are happening.

items.title: CVE-2025-22457: Ivanti Connect Secure remote code execution via stack buffer overflow (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Ivanti Connect Secure, Ivanti Policy Secure, and Ivanti ZTA Gateways are affected by a stack-based buffer overflow flaw. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit it to run arbitrary code on the affected system.

items.title: CVE-2026-20045: Cisco Unified Communications Manager remote code execution in web management interface (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Cisco Unified Communications Manager, its IM and Presence Service, and Cisco Unity Connection have a flaw in how they check input in web requests, which lets an attacker run commands on the underlying operating system and gain full root control. It can be reached remotely, without logging in, through the web-based management interface, and it is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-50522: Microsoft SharePoint Enterprise Server 2016 remote code execution via unsafe deserialization (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Microsoft SharePoint Server (including the Enterprise Server 2016, Server 2019 and Subscription Edition releases) has a flaw in how it handles untrusted data, which lets an attacker run code on the SharePoint server. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in or any user action, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2021-22893: Pulse Connect Secure authentication bypass in Windows File Share Browser (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Pulse Connect Secure, a VPN gateway product, is affected through its Windows File Share Browser and Pulse Secure Collaboration features. An unauthenticated attacker could bypass login and run arbitrary code on the gateway.

items.title: CVE-2015-3306: ProFTPD access control bypass in mod_copy (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The mod_copy module in ProFTPD, an FTP server (including the Debian proftpd-dfsg package), lets an attacker copy files around on the server and possibly run arbitrary code. The attacker can do this remotely without logging in by using the "site cpfr" and "site cpto" commands. Public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available, and attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2026-20320: Cisco BroadWorks remote file read via XXE in OCI XML parser (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Cisco BroadWorks has a flaw in how its OCI-P service handles XML, letting an attacker read sensitive files, including configuration information, from the system with the privileges of the BroadWorks user. It can be exploited remotely without logging in by sending a crafted XML message, public exploit code is available, and attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2026-129448: Apache Roller unauthenticated code execution in XML-RPC endpoint (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Apache Roller has a deserialization flaw in its XML-RPC endpoint that lets a remote attacker run arbitrary code on the server without logging in. The endpoint deserializes vendor extension types before it checks the requester's identity.

items.title: CVE-2018-8581: Microsoft Exchange privilege escalation in email server software (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. This vulnerability affects Microsoft Exchange Server, Microsoft's email and collaboration server software. An attacker who can already run code or access the system could exploit it to gain higher privileges than they are authorized to have.

items.title: CVE-2026-20963: Microsoft SharePoint Enterprise Server 2016 remote code execution via unsafe deserialization (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Microsoft SharePoint Server (including the 2016 Enterprise, 2019, and Subscription Edition releases) has a flaw in how it handles untrusted data, which lets an attacker run code on the server. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in or any user interaction, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-135742
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in recv_msg() of the zmq and azmq filters that allows unauthenticated network attackers to corrupt memory by sending oversized command messages. Attackers can send a 4 GiB message to the default listening port, truncating the int buffer size so memcpy() writes past the heap allocation and crashes FFmpeg.

items.title: CVE-2026-121019
items.summary: An unauthenticated attacker can trick a local user into generating an offline boot application from a malicious CODESYS project, causing the affected products to write files in arbitrary directories on the engineering workstation. The destination path is derived from attacker-controlled project data, whereas the file name and file contents are generated by the affected products and are not attacker-controlled.

items.title: CVE-2026-121018
items.summary: The affected products insufficiently restrict runtime-supplied visualization commands, allowing local functionality on the engineering workstation to be invoked, if a user is both logged in to a CODESYS Control runtime and operates a visualization. An unauthenticated remote attacker controlling a malicious runtime and tricking a user to trust it, or performing a man-in-the-middle attack on the communication between the CODESYS Control runtime and the engineering workstation, may cause arbitrary code execution on the engineering workstation.

items.title: CVE-2026-135743
items.summary: FFmpeg 4.3 before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability in the dynaudnorm filter because cqueue_resize() miscalculates gain history queue element counts when gausssize changes at runtime. Attackers can send gausssize commands via asendcmd scripts or an unauthenticated azmq filter to corrupt heap memory, crashing the process or potentially executing code.

items.title: CVE-2026-135739
items.summary: FFmpeg 7.1 before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_scale.c that allows attackers to read past the filter input array by sending width or height commands using ref variables. Attackers can send such commands via sendcmd scripts or unauthenticated zmq or azmq filters, causing config_props() to dereference an invalid pointer and crash the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-135736
items.summary: FFmpeg 4.4 before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_deband.c that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by sending a runtime coupling command. Attackers can send a 'deband coupling 1' command via sendcmd or an unauthenticated zmq filter, making chroma planes be processed at luma dimensions to crash the process or potentially execute code.

items.title: CVE-2026-135696
items.summary: rConfig Core 8.2.19 before 8.2.22 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass the DeviceIpIsValid loopback guard by supplying unresolved hostnames. Attackers can create a device with a hostname resolving to loopback and device_port_override 6379, causing configuration downloads to send Redis inline commands for remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-135688
items.summary: Idno through 1.6.4 contains an unauthenticated blind server-side request forgery vulnerability in the /webmention/ endpoint that fetches attacker-supplied source URLs without scheme, host, or IP validation. Attackers can set target to a local page and source to loopback, private-network, or cloud metadata addresses, then infer internal service reachability from response status and timing.

items.title: CVE-2026-127026
items.summary: The 3D Website Builder WordPress plugin through 2.0.3 does not perform any authorisation check in one of its publicly accessible AJAX actions, and the nonce guarding it is exposed to visitors on any page embedding the 3D Website Builder WordPress plugin through 2.0.3's shortcode, allowing unauthenticated users to permanently delete any of the 3D Website Builder WordPress plugin through 2.0.3's 3D builder objects and their slides.

items.title: CVE-2026-135690

items.title: CVE-2026-101871

items.title: CVE-2026-132615
items.summary: The ggml-rpc server suffers from an uninitialized heap memory disclosure vulnerability where the alloc_buffer function provides new clients with buffers containing stale data from previously freed allocations. This allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to perform an in-bounds read via get_tensor to recover sensitive information, such as model weights or KV-cache data, belonging to other clients sharing the same server.

items.title: CVE-2026-135470
items.summary: WPC Product Options for WooCommerce before 4.0.9 contains a price manipulation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to purchase products at an arbitrary price by submitting crafted wpcpo-* option data with a negative price in an add-to-cart request. Attackers can exploit the add_cart_item_data() function in includes/class-cart.php, which stores client-supplied price values without validation and carries them into the order total via before_calculate_totals(), to checkout products at zero or arbitrary cost.

items.title: CVE-2026-135436
items.summary: KindleEar 3.0.0 through 3.5.3 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated non-admin users to run Python code by uploading malicious recipes. Attackers can send POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE requests to /api/v1/tournaments to create, modify or delete tournaments, cascading deletion to teams and speakers.

Unauthenticated attackers can craft REST links setting automura_gf_file to script HTML and automura_gf_file_type to text/html, executing JavaScript with a victim administrator's session.

items.title: CVE-2026-135211
items.summary: BISHENG before 3.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the /api/v2/workflow/invoke and /api/v2/workflow/stop routes that allows unauthenticated attackers to run workflows as the administrator. Attackers knowing a workflow UUID can supply an override replacing a Code node's code parameter with Python passed to exec(), achieving remote code execution, or stop other users' workflow sessions.

items.title: CVE-2026-132779
items.summary: When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use TLS 1.3 early data using the ssl_early_data on directive, an attacker can use a specially crafted TLS 1.3 connection to drive an NGINX worker into a tight loop in which it repeatedly retries the same send without ever making progress. The worker continues accepting new connections and handling existing ones, but one CPU core is pinned at 100%. items.title: CVE-2026-135208
items.summary: Kerberos Agent before 3.14.4 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens because JWTMiddleWare() falls back to the hard-coded key TOBECHANGED. Attackers can sign HS256 tokens with arbitrary username and role claims to access /api and /config routes, exposing RTSP, ONVIF, Hub and encryption keys, rewriting configuration, and stopping the camera.

items.summary: In ServerSessionBroker of server_session_broker.cc, there is a possible use after free due to a race condition. This could lead to remote code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

items.title: CVE-2026-95449
items.summary: In NexustalkStream::PullFrameTask of nexustalk_stream.cc, there is a possible use after free due to a race condition. This could lead to remote code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is needed for exploitation.

items.title: CVE-2026-135293
items.summary: Contiki-NG through 5.2 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in icmp_in() in os/net/ipv6/multicast/mpl.c that allows unauthenticated attackers to hang nodes via crafted MPL control messages. Attackers on the same link can send an MPL data message to create a seed entry, then an all-zero bit vector control message causing index wraparound and denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-135292
items.summary: Contiki-NG through 5.2 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the MPL multicast engine that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to corrupt memory via unchecked seed ID lengths. Attackers can send near-maximum-size MPL messages with an S=3 option in a short hop-by-hop header, causing data_message_expiration() to write 16 bytes past uip_buf and crash the node.

items.title: CVE-2026-135286
items.summary: phpwcms before 1.9.53, 1.12.7 and 2.0.0-beta.4 contains a host header poisoning vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to control password reminder links by sending a forged X-Forwarded-Host header. Attackers can submit the public password reminder form for a victim so the emailed {LOGIN_URL} points to an attacker host, capturing the new password when the victim logs in there.

items.title: CVE-2026-129976
items.summary: Memory Allocation with Excessive Size Value (CWE-789) in Packetbeat can lead to denial of service via a specially crafted, malformed Cassandra protocol message. An unauthenticated attacker who can send traffic on a network segment that Packetbeat monitors can cause Packetbeat to allocate excessive memory and terminate. Elastic Agent is also affected when the Network Packet Capture integration monitors Cassandra traffic, because it uses the same protocol decoder.

items.title: CVE-2026-135175
items.summary: ZITADEL 4.19.5 before 4.20.3 contains a host header injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect notification links by placing a trusted host in the userinfo portion of the x-zitadel-public-host header. Attackers knowing a victim's login name can harvest single-use codes from password-reset links sent to their host, reset passwords, and take over accounts including administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-135171
items.summary: Wing FTP Server before 8.2.8 contains a predictable session identifier vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to hijack administrator sessions by deriving identifiers from process, time, ServerID, and client IP state. Attackers can enumerate candidate identifiers using the service_get_license.html endpoint as a validity oracle and replay live sessions to gain administrative control including the Lua console.

items.title: CVE-2026-135165
items.summary: CISO Assistant before 4.2.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to block all logins by exhausting a shared rate limit keyed on the frontend server IP. Attackers can send a low sustained rate of failed login attempts through the SvelteKit frontend to exhaust the django-allauth per-address budget, locking out every user.

items.title: CVE-2026-135162
items.summary: Sim 0.5.61 before 0.9.41 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows write-level workspace members to change workflow MCP server visibility without admin permission. Attackers can set isPublic via POST or PATCH to /api/mcp/workflow-servers, exposing deployed workflows to unauthenticated invocation through /api/mcp/serve.

items.title: CVE-2026-135161
items.summary: Interstellar before 6.3.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach internal services by enabling allow_loopback_ips and allow_private_ips in wisp-js at startup. Attackers can open a wisp WebSocket that bypasses the Express password middleware and create TCP streams to loopback, internal hosts, or cloud metadata services.

items.summary: The weDevs Subscribe2 WordPress plugin 10.35 before 10.50 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to remove public subscribers by forging the s2_unsub GET parameter. Openwave Messaging's Webtop Media Transcoder does not enforce the file type restrictions set by administrators, so an authenticated user can convert document types that were meant to be blocked. items.title: Mangoose - Use of Out-of-range Pointer Offset in X.509 Certificate ECDSA Signature Parsing
items.summary: Mangoose - Use of Out-of-range Pointer Offset in X.509 Certificate ECDSA Signature Parsing In Mongoose, the built-in TLS stack ( MG_TLS=MG_TLS_BUILTIN ) parses the ECDSA signature of a peer's X.509 certificate in mg_tls_verify_cert_signature() ( src/tls_builtin.c ). A vulnerable version of the service can give attackers a way into the video management server if it is directly accessible [...] The post GeoVision Servers Targeted in XMRig Campaign: How to Check GV-WebCam Exposure appeared first on CIP Blog .

items.title: Hackers Exploited GL.iNet Cloud Flaw to Install Malware on Routers and KVM Devices
items.summary: Hackers exploited a vulnerability in GL.iNet's GoodCloud remote management service to install malware on some customer routers and KVM devices, the maker of travel routers and remote-access KVM hardware said in a security notice updated today. items.title: CVE-2026-132257
items.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. From versions 0.6.23 and above, before 0.8.0, AutoGPT Platform ships a hardcoded default Fernet encryption key in backend/.env.default, which encrypts every user's OAuth tokens, API keys, and integration credentials in the User.integrations column. Anyone with read access to the database of a deployment using the default key can decrypt the stored credentials. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.0.

Before the fix, firewall policy processing used string operations without sufficient destination-size checks and did not consistently validate array bounds. Malformed or oversized configuration data may cause an out-of-bounds write and corrupt stack memory. Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

items.title: CVE-2026-134898
items.summary: A path traversal vulnerability in the File Explorer share-link folder-listing endpoint allows a remote attacker with a folder-scoped share link to list directory contents outside the shared folder, including other Samba shares readable by the link creator, because path validation occurs before path canonicalization. Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

items.title: CVE-2026-134895
items.summary: A path traversal vulnerability in the File Explorer share-link upload component allows a remote attacker with a folder-scoped upload share link to upload or overwrite files in the shared folder's immediate parent directory due to missing trailing validation prior to path canonicalization. Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

items.title: CVE-2026-120945
items.summary: A relative path traversal vulnerability in the FTP Backup of ADM, allows an attacker controlling a configured FTP server to cause files to be created or overwritten outside the selected NAS backup destination. Successful exploitation can modify or destroy files writable by that identity. Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

items.title: CVE-2026-120942
items.summary: A path traversal vulnerability in the regional options of ADM allows attackers to read arbitrary files on the system. The function fails to properly canonicalize user-supplied directory paths, enabling attackers to bypass path restriction checks via crafted path traversal sequences. Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

items.title: CVE-2026-135779
items.summary: Reliance on an untrusted source of the client address in the WebSocket listener of the NetBird relay server (relay/server/listener/ws) in NetBird versions 0.31.1 through 0.74.7 allows an attacker with an enrolled peer to spoof the source address of their relay connection. The listener used the values of the X-Real-Ip and X-Real-Port request headers as the remote address of the connection unconditionally, without checking that the request came from a trusted upstream proxy. A WebSocket client that sends both headers makes the relay record and use an arbitrary address for its connection, includi…

items.title: CVE-2026-120935
items.summary: An argument injection vulnerability exists in the settings/vpn.cgi endpoint in the ADM. When processing a WireGuard profile, the internal command parser removes quotes and performs a quote-agnostic scan on arguments without properly sanitizing redirection operators. An authenticated administrator can supply a crafted parameter to cause the execution helper to open and truncate arbitrary files on the filesystem with root privileges, resulting in an arbitrary file truncation and denial-of-service (DoS) condition. Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as we…

items.title: CVE-2026-120948
items.summary: An OS command injection vulnerability in the PPPoE configuration of ADM allows an authenticated administrator to store shell syntax in the PPPoE account value. When the service loads the resulting configuration, the injected commands can execute with root privileges. Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

items.title: CVE-2026-134897
items.summary: An OS command injection vulnerability in ADM allows an authenticated administrator to create an iSCSI LUN with a crafted name and schedule a snapshot. The scheduler embeds the name in a root cron job without correctly neutralizing shell metacharacters, allowing arbitrary command execution as root when the job runs. Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

items.title: CVE-2026-134896
items.summary: An improper input validation vulnerability in the OpenVPN client configuration import feature of ADM allows authenticated administrative users to execute arbitrary operating system commands via a crafted .ovpn profile. Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

items.title: CVE-2026-120934
items.summary: An External Control of File Name or Path (Argument Injection) vulnerability in the settings/notification.cgi component of ADM allows authenticated remote administrators to create or truncate arbitrary files with root privileges via crafted request parameters. An authenticated administrator can truncate arbitrary critical files across the root filesystem, leading to system failure or Denial of Service (DoS). Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

items.title: CVE-2026-120946
items.summary: An OS command injection vulnerability in ADM allows remote authenticated administrators to execute arbitrary commands as root. The set action in settings/ddns.cgi fails to sanitize configuration delimiters in user-supplied parameters before writing them into the DDNS configuration file, allowing an attacker to inject directives that execute arbitrary system commands upon service restart. Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

items.title: CVE-2026-120936
items.summary: An arbitrary file creation and truncation vulnerability exists in the File Explorer of ADM. An authenticated low-privileged user can upload a file with crafted path components containing quote and redirection characters. When music.cgi processes the entry for audio playback operations, the unescaped path string breaks out of the expected argument context in the internal command parser. This causes the system execution helper to open the attacker-specified path with root privileges using O_TRUNC, allowing remote attackers to truncate or create arbitrary system files. Affected products and versi…

items.title: CVE-2026-134893
items.summary: An externally controlled format string vulnerability in the Snapshot CGI components of ADM allows an authenticated administrator to cause repeatable premature termination of affected privileged CGI requests by supplying crafted input. Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

items.title: CVE-2026-135725
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ff_rtmp_packet_write() in libavformat/rtmppkt.c that allows malicious RTMP servers to overflow a 16-byte header buffer. Attackers can send a Set Chunk Size packet on a high channel id with an extended timestamp, which handle_chunk_size() echoes back, corrupting the publishing client's stack.

items.title: CVE-2026-135722
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in peak_init_writer() and wav_write_packet() in libavformat/wavenc.c that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by supplying audio with zero channels. Attackers can provide a crafted PCM stream declaring no channels for WAV output with peak envelope enabled, causing out-of-bounds writes past peak_maxpos and peak_maxneg arrays, crashes, and potential code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-135706
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in modplug_read_header() in libavformat/libmodplug.c that allocates the buffer using max_size instead of sz. When max_size is set to 0, attackers can supply crafted module files that avio_read() copies into a zero-sized buffer, causing memory corruption, crashes, or possible code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-135719
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an uninitialized memory disclosure vulnerability in dxa_read_packet() in libavformat/dxa.c that ignores short avio_read() results for CMAP palette data. Attackers can supply a crafted DXA stream over a stalling network source so uninitialized stack bytes are copied into returned video packets and decoded frames.

items.title: CVE-2026-135703
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an uninitialized memory use vulnerability in asfrtp_parse_packet() in libavformat/rtpdec_asf.c that allows malicious RTP sources to leak heap contents by supplying an oversized ASF packet length. Attackers controlling an RTSP server with an x-asf-pf payload can set len_off beyond the RTP payload so the ASF demuxer returns stale heap memory as demuxed media data.

items.title: CVE-2026-133778
items.summary: #[AsLiveComponent(route: '...')] makes a live component send its requests to another route. The documentation suggests it so that the component lives under a specific firewall, for example. The default /_components/{_live_component}/{_live_action} route still served the component, though. A request to it rendered the component and ran its actions outside the firewall and the access rules of the configured route. The request needs props signed by the application, which a page that rendered the component provides. Controller attributes on the component, like #[IsGranted], still applied. A live c…

items.title: CVE-2026-133774
items.summary: A live component protected by #[IsGranted], on its class or on its default action, can be rendered by a caller who is not granted access. POST /_components/{name}/_batch is handled by Symfony\UX\LiveComponent\Controller\BatchActionController, which has no controller attributes: the attributes of the component are only checked by the sub-request issued for each action. With an empty actions list, no sub-request was issued, and the hydrated component was rendered and returned with a 200. The caller needs a valid signed props payload for the component, such as the data-live-props-value of a page…

items.title: CVE-2026-105431
items.summary: A protection mechanism failure in the userspace firewall of the NetBird client (client/firewall/uspfilter) in NetBird versions 0.55.0 through 0.74.6 allows an attacker who controls an enrolled peer to bypass the access control rules of another peer by sending IP-fragmented packets. The packet filter returned an allow verdict for any IPv4 fragment, and for any IPv6 packet carrying a Fragment extension header, before evaluating the ACL rules. This applied to the leading fragment as well as to continuation fragments, so no part of a fragmented datagram was filtered and ports denied by policy coul…

items.title: CVE-2026-135456
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in amirhamza05 Student-Management-System up to 449397e35d42e3779f14f0bfc654ab307103f7e3. This affects an unknown function of the file page_action/user/user_profile.php. The manipulation of the argument update_profile_info leads to cross-site request forgery. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. This product follows a rolling release approach for continuous delivery, so version details for affected or updated releases are not provided. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue repo…

items.title: CVE-2026-135745
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the curves filter in libavfilter/vf_curves.c that allows attackers to read past lookup tables by supplying planar high bit depth samples exceeding the nominal depth. Attackers can craft video files with unmasked gbrp9 to gbrp14 samples passed through the rawvideo decoder to crash applications or leak heap contents into output video.

items.title: CVE-2026-135744
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the lut1d filter in libavfilter/vf_lut3d.c that allows attackers to read heap memory by supplying planar high bit depth samples above the nominal depth. Attackers can craft 9, 10, 12 or 14 bit planar RGB video processed with a large 1D LUT to crash applications or disclose heap contents in output pixels.

items.title: CVE-2026-135741
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_lut2.c because the second input's pixel format is unrestricted when the output depth option is set. Attackers can supply crafted media such as monoblack BMP or PBM images to index beyond lookup tables, crashing applications or leaking heap contents into output video.

items.title: CVE-2026-135740
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_readeia608.c because build_histogram() does not clamp high bit depth luma samples to the nominal maximum. Attackers can supply crafted 9, 10, 12 or 14 bit gray or YUV video to corrupt heap memory, causing crashes or possibly code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-135738
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_signalstats.c that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by supplying high bit depth samples exceeding the nominal maximum. Attackers can craft planar 9 to 14 bit YUV video whose unclamped samples or saturation values index past histogram ends, crashing applications or possibly executing code.

items.title: CVE-2026-135737
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds write and read vulnerability in the tmidequalizer filter that allows attackers to corrupt memory by supplying high bit depth samples exceeding the nominal maximum. Attackers can craft planar 9, 10, 12 or 14 bit video so compute_histogram16() and apply_contrast_change16() index unclamped samples, crashing applications, corrupting the heap, and leaking heap contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-135735
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in filter_slice_rgba_planar() that allows attackers to read beyond lookup tables using unmasked high bit depth planar samples. Attackers can supply crafted video with samples exceeding the nominal depth, passed unchanged by rawvideo, to crash the application or leak heap contents into output video.

items.title: CVE-2026-135734
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the deflicker filter that lets attackers corrupt heap memory via unclamped high bit depth luma samples. Attackers can supply crafted video whose luma values exceed the nominal depth, making calc_avgy16() increment counters past the histogram allocation, causing crashes or possibly code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-135732
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in mxf_write_d10_audio_packet() in libavformat/mxfenc.c because mxf_init() accepts unsupported D-10 audio codecs. Attackers can supply a crafted input with a non-PCM multichannel audio stream remuxed to D-10 MXF to leak heap memory into the output file or crash the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-135730
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an uninitialized memory vulnerability in vpk_read_header() in libavformat/vpk.c that computes a last block size not divisible by the channel count. Attackers can supply a crafted VPK file with a large channel count so the last audio packet exposes leftover heap memory contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-135729
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an XML injection vulnerability in write_adaptation_set() in libavformat/webmdashenc.c that writes stream language metadata unescaped into the AdaptationSet lang attribute. Attackers can supply crafted WebM files whose track language contains quotes or angle brackets to inject attributes or elements, controlling segment URLs and representations in generated MPD manifests.

items.title: CVE-2026-135728
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a signed integer overflow vulnerability in libavformat/dashdec.c that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying a crafted DASH manifest. Attackers can craft an MPD manifest with very long BaseURL and SegmentTemplate strings to overflow max_url_size, causing undersized URL allocations and denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-135727
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an uninitialized memory disclosure vulnerability in rfc4175_handle_packet() in libavformat/rtpdec_rfc4175.c that leaks heap contents into decoded video frames. Attackers can send RTP streams containing only some scan lines of a frame, leaving av_malloc buffer bytes uninitialized and exposing process heap memory in displayed, stored or re-streamed video.

items.title: CVE-2026-135726
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in rdt_parse_packet() in libavformat/rdt.c that allows remote attackers to crash applications by omitting the ASMRuleBook SDP attribute. Attackers can serve an RTSP session selecting RDT transport without ASMRuleBook, then send an RDT data packet to crash ffmpeg or ffprobe.

items.title: CVE-2026-135724
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in avformat_stream_group_create() in libavformat/options.c that sets the group type before allocating parameters. Attackers can supply crafted HEIF/AVIF files whose tile grid parsing under allocation failure makes ff_free_stream_group() dereference a NULL tile_grid, crashing the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-135723
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a double free vulnerability in the fill_marker() function of libavformat/imf_cpl.c that frees a Marker label without clearing the pointer when default scope allocation fails. Attackers can supply a crafted Composition Playlist with a Marker Label lacking a scope attribute, triggering a second free in imf_marker_free() under memory pressure and causing memory corruption or a crash.

items.title: CVE-2026-135721
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in ff_rtp_send_vc2hq() in libavformat/rtpenc_vc2hq.c that accepts a Dirac next parse offset of zero. Attackers can supply crafted Dirac/VC-2 video remuxed to the RTP muxer, causing the parsing pointer to never advance and consume CPU indefinitely.

items.title: CVE-2026-135720
items.summary: FFmpeg 9.0 before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in dash_read_header() in libavformat/dashdec.c when building LCEVC stream groups without checking for a missing codecs string. Attackers can supply a crafted MPD manifest with a representation declaring a dependencyId but no codecs attribute to crash applications using the DASH demuxer.

items.title: CVE-2026-135718
items.summary: FFmpeg 7.0 before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dvdvideo_audio_stream_add_all() in libavformat/dvdvideodec.c when parsing menu audio streams. Attackers can supply a crafted DVD image whose menu IFO declares more than 8 audio streams, reading past the audio_control array and crashing applications.

items.title: CVE-2026-135717
items.summary: FFmpeg 8.0 before 9.1 contains a use of uninitialized memory vulnerability in opus_parse_packet() in libavformat/rtpdec_opus.c that reads the Opus TOC byte from stale buffer memory when parsing empty RTP payloads. A malicious RTSP server or RTP sender can deliver an empty Opus payload to cause incorrect packet durations and leak bits of stale memory through pkt->duration.

items.title: CVE-2026-135716
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in build_frame_code() in libavformat/nutenc.c that allows attackers to corrupt the header_len[] array by supplying inputs with many audio streams. Attackers can remux a crafted input with many audio streams to NUT, causing out-of-bounds reads past static header tables and crashing the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-135715
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the AVIF muxer in libavformat/movenc.c that allows attackers to crash the application through streams with unknown pixel formats. Attackers can supply a crafted input whose video stream is stream-copied to AVIF, causing unchecked av_pix_fmt_desc_get() results to be dereferenced, resulting in denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-135714
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in amf_get_field_value2() in libavformat/rtmppkt.c that NUL-terminates truncated AMF strings at the declared length instead of bytes read. A malicious RTMP server, or connecting client in listen mode, can send truncated onStatus or _error strings to leak uninitialized stack memory through log messages.

items.title: CVE-2026-135713
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in libavformat/mmst.c that allows malicious MMS servers to crash clients by sending malformed ASF headers. Attackers can send an ASF header lacking a packet size or stream properties, causing mms_open() to return success after freeing state and crash on first read.

items.title: CVE-2026-135712
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in the split_planes size check of write_packet() in libavformat/img2enc.c that allows out-of-bounds heap reads. Attackers can supply a crafted input whose rawvideo stream declares very large width and height, remuxed into .y image files, to leak heap memory into output files or crash the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-135711
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an XML injection vulnerability in ttml_write_header() in libavformat/ttmlenc.c that writes stream language metadata unescaped into the xml:lang attribute. Attackers can supply media files, such as Matroska subtitle tracks with crafted Language values, to inject markup into converted TTML documents and alter downstream parsing or rendering.

items.title: CVE-2026-135710
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an uninitialized memory disclosure vulnerability in vmd_read_packet() in libavformat/sierravmd.c that leaves 16 packet bytes unwritten for Indeo3 frames. Attackers can supply a crafted VMD file with Indeo3 video to expose leftover heap contents in demuxed packets, such as stream-copied output files.

items.title: CVE-2026-135709
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in ogg_buffer_data() in libavformat/oggenc.c because ogg_buffer_page() leaves a full page current after failed allocation. When page allocation fails, a memset with length (size_t)-1 or an overflowing memcpy writes past the segment table, causing heap memory corruption and crashes when writing Ogg output.

items.title: CVE-2026-135708
items.summary: FFmpeg 8.0 before 9.1 contains an improper URL scheme validation vulnerability in the WHIP muxer that allows malicious WHIP servers to create or truncate local files via the Location header. Attackers can return a file: URL that dispose_session() opens read-write with truncation on teardown, destroying arbitrary user-writable files or redirecting requests to other protocols.

items.title: CVE-2026-135707
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an uninitialized memory vulnerability in nist_read_header() in libavformat/nistspheredec.c, where an inverted ff_alloc_extradata() return check leaves the embedded-shorten extradata byte uninitialized. Attackers can supply a crafted NIST SPHERE file declaring pcm,embedded-shorten coding to leak an uninitialized heap byte into copied output or trigger a NULL pointer write on allocation failure.

items.title: CVE-2026-135705
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a stack out-of-bounds read vulnerability in ff_h264_parse_framesize() in libavformat/rtpdec_h264.c when parsing an SDP a=framesize attribute lacking a height. Attackers controlling an RTSP server DESCRIBE response or a crafted .sdp file can make atoi() read past the line buffer, crashing clients or parsing stale stack bytes.

items.title: CVE-2026-135704
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the MXG demuxer's mxg_read_packet() that allows attackers to leak uninitialized heap memory through truncated marker segments. Attackers can supply a crafted MXG file ending in a truncated APP13 segment with a large declared length, causing uninitialized heap contents to be emitted as audio packet payload, for example into remuxed output files.

items.summary: Admin password stored in plaintext at /data/data/com.acer.android.m3.webserver/shared_prefs/userInfo.xml, allowing any app with root or file access to read credentials directly.

items.title: CVE-2026-128796
items.summary: System service 'antaiuiserver' exposes transaction 14 (sendMyATCmd) & 4, allowing ANY app on device to send arbitrary AT commands to modem without permissions (no READ_PHONE_STATE, SEND_SMS). Enables reading IMEI, IMSI, ICCID, and managing SMS.

items.title: CVE-2026-105303
items.summary: The log viewer of Zoraxy admin panel fails to neutralize the output properly, that may cause an arbitrary script to be executed on the administrator's browser.

items.title: CVE-2026-77918
items.summary: Gogs through 0.14.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to view private forks by querying fork listings without per-fork read checks. items.title: CVE-2026-18530
items.summary: OS command injection in the a3cli restricted shell in Lantronix S2220 Series 2 allows an authenticated attacker to bypass shell restrictions and execute arbitrary operating system commands via unsanitized command substitution metacharacters, including backticks and $(), in parameters of permitted commands over SSH. items.summary: Tanium addressed an information disclosure vulnerability in Enforce Recovery Key Portal.

items.title: CVE-2026-135695
items.summary: rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.13 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.0 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability in the users API that allows authenticated users to modify other accounts. items.summary: A weakness has been identified in FredrikNoren ungit 1.5.30. Affected by this issue is the function credentialsOption of the file source/git-api.js of the component Remote Git API. Executing a manipulation of the argument Remote can lead to os command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: CVE-2026-135442
items.summary: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the MPEG-4 Visual parser that allows attackers to read global memory via an uninitialized frame_rate_code index into Mpegv_frame_rate. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file that forces stream finalization before parser synchronization, crashing the process or leaking adjacent memory into the reported frame rate.

items.title: CVE-2026-135430
items.summary: KindleEar 3.0.0 through 3.5.3 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in application/view/subscribe.py that allows authenticated users to access other users' records by id without ownership checks. Attackers can enumerate sequential recipe ids to read recipe source containing credentials, delete recipes and custom RSS feeds, and overwrite saved site logins.

items.title: CVE-2026-134401
items.summary: Improper input validation in Variations in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.88 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Critical)

items.title: CVE-2026-133455
items.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. Prior to 0.9.0, nested tools invoked by OrchestratorBlock bypass the main execution queue and are charged only after succeeding, but post-run billing still refunds a failed tool's catalogue price as a presumed pre-flight charge. Any authenticated customer can trigger failed nested calls to add uncharged credits to their balance and fund later executions using the operator's credentials. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-135120
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in RainyGao DocSys up to 2.02.91. Affected by this vulnerability is the function downloadDocRS of the file src/com/DocSystem/controller/DocController.java. Performing a manipulation of the argument path results in path traversal. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: CVE-2026-133930
items.summary: A pooled-buffer lifetime error in Elasticsearch ES|QL Arrow response formatting can disclose data from other users' concurrent requests. An authenticated user with read access to an index who requests Arrow output containing an affected column type can receive data from indices they are not authorized to access. A temporary block can be released to a shared memory pool before deferred response writers finish using it, allowing concurrent requests to reuse the same memory. The attacker cannot select which concurrent data is disclosed.

This issue affects Apache Jena Fuseki through 6.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.3.0, which fixes the issue. items.title: CVE-2026-49965
items.summary: DreameHome cloud API before 2026-11-19 contained an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the POST /smart-app/meari-cloud/bindDevice endpoint that allows authenticated attackers to reassign another user's camera to their own Dreame account. The endpoint accepted binding requests from accounts that did not own the camera, so an attacker with the camera identifiers could supply their own user identity, become the camera's masterUid, and remove the camera from the owner's device list, denying the owner access through DreameHome.

items.title: CVE-2026-49964
items.summary: DreameHome cloud API before 2026-10-14 contained an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the POST /dreame-user-iot/token/rtc2 endpoint that allows authenticated attackers to obtain an Agora RTC token for another user's device by supplying its device DID and owner UID. The endpoint issued the token without verifying device ownership, allowing attackers to join the device's live-video channel and publish video under the targeted device's identity.

items.title: CVE-2026-49963
items.summary: DreameHome for Android (com.dreame.smartlife) before 2.6.4.0 contains a download of code without integrity check vulnerability in RnPluginDownloadManager.java that allows network-positioned attackers to execute arbitrary JavaScript within the application by replacing React Native feature bundles that are only validated against a client-stored MD5 checksum without publisher authentication. Attackers can replace both the downloaded bundle and its corresponding MD5 metadata to run modified code with the application's permissions and access to its bridge APIs.

items.title: CVE-2026-135090

Affected by this vulnerability is the function NewInviteNotification::html of the file notifications/NewInviteNotification.php of the component Notification Rendering. Executing a manipulation can lead to cross site scripting. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. Upgrading to version 1.2.2 addresses this issue. This patch is called 6c82534ffcb90e74229671a76caef1a8285c5190. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

items.title: CVE-2026-130169
items.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.26 through 0.7.4, AutoGPT Platform ships a publicly known, hardcoded default JWT verification key in backend/.env.default and autogpt_platform/.env.default. Because HS256 is symmetric, anyone who knows the secret can forge valid JWTs for any user or for the admin role, bypassing authentication and authorization without user interaction. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-135089
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in humhub questions up to 1.1.5. Affected is an unknown function of the file widgets/views/answer.php of the component QA Module. Performing a manipulation of the argument displayName results in cross site scripting. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. Upgrading to version 1.1.6 is able to address this issue. The patch is named cdc39878ba457ca71271c1ec3cf05fe025e3e9fc. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

items.title: CVE-2026-49961
items.summary: DreameHome MQTT broker before 2026-10-26 contained an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to subscribe to another device's status topic /status/{DID}/{UID}/{model}/# without owning or having access to the device. Attackers who know the device DID, owner UID, and model can receive the device's telemetry, including compressed LiDAR map frames exposing the home's layout, the Wi-Fi SSID and BSSID, local IP address, gateway, firmware version, and the session key used for encrypted video.

items.title: CVE-2026-49960
items.summary: DreameHome cloud API before 2026-10-14 contained an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the POST /smart-app/meari-cloud/redirectAndLogin endpoint that allows authenticated attackers to obtain another user's Meari camera-platform identity and session credentials by supplying that user's uid. The endpoint used the caller-supplied uid to select the Meari account without verifying that it belonged to the account authenticated by the Dreame-Auth token. Attackers can obtain target uids through public forum profiles and an email-to-uid lookup, and use the leaked credentials to access li…

items.title: CVE-2026-135452
items.summary: A potential security vulnerability has been identified in the HP Hotkey UWP Service, which might allow escalation of privilege. HP is releasing mitigation for the potential vulnerability. Customers using HP Programmable Key are recommended to update HP Hotkey Support.

items.title: CVE-2026-49962
items.summary: DreameHome device sharing and MQTT broker before 2026-10-26 contained an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows former share recipients to keep receiving a device's MQTT status messages after the owner revokes sharing. Revocation removed application access and the device-command API rejected the former recipient, but the broker still accepted subscriptions to the device's status topic using the DID, owner UID, and model exposed during sharing, allowing continued monitoring of the home's map data and device status.

items.title: CVE-2026-135299
items.summary: Convoy before 26.3.7 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows any project API key holder, including viewer-scoped keys, to read host files via require() in JavaScript transform functions. Attackers can submit a function to the sources/test_function endpoint calling require on a file path to disclose configuration files containing database credentials and secrets.

items.title: CVE-2026-135298
items.summary: Convoy before 26.6.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in /portal-api single-resource handlers that allows portal link token holders to access other tenants' resources by ID. Attackers with another tenant's resource IDs in the same project can read endpoint signing secrets and webhook payloads, rotate secrets, pause or delete endpoints, and force event re-delivery.

items.title: CVE-2026-135088
items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in ONLYOFFICE onlyoffice-humhub up to 4.0.0. This impacts the function html of the file notifications/Mention.php of the component Mention Notification Handler. Such manipulation of the argument Comment leads to cross site scripting. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-102952
items.summary: The Zephyr TFTP client in subsys/net/lib/tftp/tftp_client.c does not check where the reply to its request comes from. After sending a read or write request to the configured server, send_request() accepts the first UDP datagram that arrives on the client's socket from any address and port. It then calls zsock_connect() to that sender, so the sender becomes the peer for the rest of the transfer. RFC 1350 requires a client to discard datagrams whose source does not match the transfer ID it expects. A host that can send a UDP datagram to the client's ephemeral port before the real server replies…

items.title: CVE-2026-135415
items.summary: A flaw has been found in MiniMax up to 0.7.2. Affected is the function authorizedLocalScript of the file bash-checker.ts. Executing a manipulation can lead to improper authorization. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-101864
items.summary: EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit a4161a9, contains a weak password recovery mechanism that allows attackers who obtain a still-valid password-reset link to take over accounts that use a local EUSurvey password. The /auth/reset/ flow checks only the age of a reset code and does not invalidate it after the password is changed, and issuing a newer link leaves earlier links active, so a used or superseded link remains valid for up to 24 hours from issuance and can be reused to set a new password, sign in as the affected user, and lock that user out.

items.title: CVE-2026-135445
items.summary: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains a divide-by-zero vulnerability in TimeCode::FromString() that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying hour-unit timestamps with fewer than three fractional digits. Attackers can craft a TTML file whose begin or end attribute contains such a timestamp, causing MediaInfo or embedding applications to crash with SIGFPE when opened.

items.title: CVE-2026-135444
items.summary: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in File_Mpegv::Streams_Fill() that allows attackers to read adjacent memory via an uninitialized chroma_format index. Attackers can craft media files that reach Streams_Fill() before Synched_Init(), crashing MediaInfo or embedding applications and possibly exposing static memory in parser output.

items.title: CVE-2026-135443
items.summary: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the VC-1 parser that uses uninitialized AspectRatio, profile and colordiff_format members as unchecked table indices. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file that finalizes the VC-1 stream before synchronization, crashing the process and potentially exposing adjacent memory in reported metadata.

items.title: CVE-2026-135441
items.summary: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains an uninitialized pointer dereference vulnerability because the File_Mpeg4_Descriptors constructor leaves the IsCmaf pointer holding stale heap contents. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file with an AAC/USAC decoder specific descriptor so File_Usac::Streams_Finish_Conformance_Profile dereferences an invalid address, crashing the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-135440
items.summary: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in the Vorbis setup header parser that allows attackers to trigger reads of freed memory via crafted files. Attackers can supply a crafted Ogg/Vorbis file that makes File_Vorbis::Setup() return early without BS_End_LE(), leaving a stale bitstream pointer that causes crashes or heap disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-135439
items.summary: Fusion through 1.3.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass private-address protection by submitting URLs to the POST /api/feeds/validate endpoint. Attackers can supply a public URL that redirects or links to loopback, private, or link-local addresses, making feedfinder request internal services and leak parsed titles in responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-135438
items.summary: Anchr before 3.7.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to host HTML files by uploading them through the image upload feature with a spoofed image content type. Attackers can upload an .html file served via GET /api/image/:id from the Anchr origin, running script that steals the victim's localStorage session token for account takeover.

items.title: CVE-2026-135437
items.summary: Firefly Pico through 1.12.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to overwrite other users' profiles by supplying arbitrary profile IDs. Attackers with an access token can send another user's sequential ID to the ProfileController update method, reassigning the profile and destroying the victim's saved settings.

items.title: CVE-2026-135435
items.summary: Daptin before 0.13.61 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to overwrite restricted contacts by sending CardDAV PUT requests to existing contacts. Attackers holding address book Update permission can bypass per-contact row permissions in PutAddressObject to modify protected contacts and confirm their existence.

items.title: CVE-2026-135434
items.summary: django-appointment before 3.14.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated staff members to modify other staff members' appointments by supplying arbitrary appointment IDs. Attackers can send POST requests to /ajax/update_appt_date_time/ with sequential appointment_id values to reschedule appointments, rewriting date, start and end times and reminders.

items.title: CVE-2026-135432
items.summary: sdcb Chats 1.10.0 before 1.17.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in GetAssignedUserDetails that allows assigned non-admin users to read other users' per-user MCP headers. Attackers can request the assigned-user-details endpoint to obtain bearer tokens in CustomHeaders and impersonate other users against the downstream MCP server.

items.title: CVE-2026-135431
items.summary: MyBibliotheca 3.0.0 before 3.0.4 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to modify or delete other users' books via /api/v1/books/. Attackers can obtain book UUIDs from recently added books across all owners, then send PUT or DELETE requests to rename, alter, or permanently delete them.

The Controller_StaffGroup.RunChecks() method concatenates the unsanitized title value directly into a duplicate name lookup query against the staffgroup table, allowing attackers to read or modify database contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-135209
items.summary: ServerOS Panel before 1.10.1 contains a decompression bomb vulnerability in DeploySourcePacker::extract() that allows authenticated users with manage-machines permission to bypass the 4 GB unpacked-size limit by under-declaring zip entry sizes. Attackers can upload a crafted archive via POST /machines/{machine}/sources whose entries inflate far beyond declared sizes, filling the host disk and denying service to all workspaces.

items.title: CVE-2026-133981
items.summary: An issue was discovered in Elasticsearch where specially crafted compressed payloads can cause an infinite loop. A low-privileged authenticated user can submit a malformed payload to a product API endpoint that causes the node to enter a permanent CPU loop, occupying a request-processing thread indefinitely. This can progressively exhaust the node's processing capacity, degrading or denying access to product features, and requiring a restart of the affected node to recover.

items.title: CVE-2026-115296
items.summary: Missing authorization in Kibana Security AI Assistant conversation deletion can allow an authenticated assistant user to permanently delete a shared or global conversation owned by another user in the same space. The individual-delete path can treat read access to a shared conversation as permission to delete it without checking ownership. The deleted conversation history is lost to its legitimate owner.

items.title: CVE-2026-133860
items.summary: An issue in Kibana allows Elasticsearch transforms in directly uploaded integration packages to run with Kibana's internal system identity instead of the installing user's privileges. A user with Integrations: All and Agent policies: All privileges in a single Kibana space could access or modify data they are not authorized to access, including agent policies from other spaces. This could disclose sensitive information or lead to command execution on managed Elastic Agent hosts.

items.title: CVE-2026-115291
items.summary: Missing authorization in Kibana Security AI Assistant conversation deletion can allow an authenticated user with access to the assistant to delete other users' conversations in the same space. The delete-all operation can issue a query without an ownership filter using the assistant's internal Elasticsearch client. A user can consequently delete conversation history that they do not own or have permission to modify.

items.title: CVE-2026-133926
items.summary: An issue was discovered in Kibana where a user with the Synthetics All privilege in one space can access Fleet agent policy metadata from other spaces through a product API endpoint. This could lead to the unauthorized disclosure of operational metadata across spaces the user is not authorized to view.

items.title: CVE-2026-135297
items.summary: Convoy before 26.6.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated dashboard users to read other organisations' data due to missing membership checks on /ui/organisations/{orgID}/ read routes. Attackers who know another organisation's ID can request members, invites/pending, and projects endpoints to obtain member emails, roles, pending invitee emails, and project lists.

items.title: CVE-2026-135296
items.summary: LibreCAD through 2.2.1.6 contains an out-of-bounds access vulnerability in picPunto::processFilePic() of the PIC import plugin that allows attackers to read past QStringList bounds via coordinate tokens lacking commas. Attackers can persuade a user to import a crafted PIC file with malformed line, circle, box or text records to crash the application and potentially modify memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-135295
items.summary: FontForge through 20251009 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in PcfReadEncodingsNames() that allows attackers to corrupt memory via negative glyph indices from truncated PCF encodings tables. Attackers can supply a crafted .pcf file imported through the GUI or scripting Import() command to write before the encs array, causing crashes or potential code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-135294
items.summary: LibreCAD through 2.2.1.6 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds write vulnerability in RS_FilterDXF1::readFileInBuffer() caused by unvalidated truncation of the 64-bit file size. Attackers can persuade users to open a crafted DXF file sized 0xFFFFFFF8 bytes, writing a NUL byte before an 8-byte buffer to corrupt heap metadata and crash the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-135291
items.summary: Contiki-NG through 5.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in rpl_remove_routes_by_nexthop() in the RPL-Classic implementation that allows adjacent attackers to crash nodes. Attackers participating in the RPL network can create a stale route whose next-hop neighbor entry was removed, then trigger parent removal to crash the node.

items.title: CVE-2026-135290
items.summary: OpenCV through 4.14.0 and 5.0.0 through 5.1.0 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in YAMLParser::parse that allows attackers to cause denial of service via crafted YAML dash lines. Attackers can supply YAML files with a non-separator '-' line after the first document, opened through cv::FileStorage, to hang the thread at full CPU.

items.title: CVE-2026-135289
items.summary: ERPSaaS 3.7.9 through 3.47.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated company users to inject script markup through unescaped client and company address fields. Attackers can store script in address lines rendered by getFormattedAddressHtml() via unescaped Blade output, executing in browsers of users viewing, previewing or printing invoices and estimates.

items.title: CVE-2026-135288
items.summary: AIOStreams 2.9.0 through 2.38.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in makeRequest() that leaks the internal secret header by matching URLs against INTERNAL_URL using a string-prefix check. Attackers can supply a custom addon manifest URL or redirect to a prefix-matching host or port to capture the secret and directly call internal addon routes.

items.title: CVE-2026-135287
items.summary: LiteLLM Proxy 1.62.4 before 1.84.0 contains a callback injection vulnerability that allows authenticated API key holders to register process-wide logging callbacks by supplying callbacks fields in request bodies. Attackers can name an unenabled observability integration such as langsmith or langfuse to leak all users' prompts and responses, or suppress operator logging via litellm_disabled_callbacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-134845
items.summary: pgjdbc, the PostgreSQL JDBC Driver, does not enforce TLS for some settings that ask for it. When sslmode is not set, an ssl value such as 1, on, yes or verify-full gives sslmode=prefer, or no TLS before 42.2.5. A service given in the Properties instead of the URL is ignored, so the sslmode of its pg_service.conf entry is lost. BaseDataSource.setUrl() keeps an sslmode, channelBinding or gssEncMode that was set before it. An attacker on the network path can then read and change the traffic. Versions 9.4.1208 through 42.7.14 are affected, and 42.7.15 fixes the problem.

items.title: CVE-2026-133917
items.summary: Elasticsearch ES|QL query responses can disclose dataset storage locations and provider identity details to users who are allowed to query a dataset but cannot read its definition. Storage paths and storage-client error text can appear in read-failure messages or query-profile plan strings. An authenticated dataset reader can obtain this information without permission to view the dataset configuration. This issue does not disclose stored credentials or the dataset contents beyond the caller's query access.

items.title: CVE-2026-95429
items.summary: In BrEdrDynamicChannel of bredr_dynamic_channel.cc, there is a possible resource exhaustion due to a missing timeout during channel configuration. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

items.title: CVE-2026-103783
items.summary: Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. A high privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-95411
items.summary: In BrEdrDynamicChannel of bredr_dynamic_channel.cc, there is a possible resource leak due to a logic error in the code. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

items.title: CVE-2026-95410
items.summary: In PeriodicAdvertisingSynchronizer::OnPeriodicAdvertisingReport of periodic_advertising_synchronizer.cc, there is a possible resource exhaustion due to a missing bounds check. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

items.title: CVE-2026-95461
items.summary: In HandleRxPacket of logical_link.cc, there is a possible resource exhaustion due to a missing limit on packets buffered for channels that are never opened. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

items.title: CVE-2026-95446
items.summary: In ProcessPdu of credit_based_flow_control_rx_engine.cc, there is a possible resource exhaustion due to improper input validation. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

items.title: CVE-2026-95434
items.summary: In LowEnergyScanner::NotifyPeerFound of low_energy_scanner.cc, there is a possible resource exhaustion due to a missing limit on the number of cached scan results. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

items.title: CVE-2026-101218
items.summary: Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. A high privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-134056
items.summary: An out-of-bounds write issue exists in padded block cipher decryption in AWS-LC. It affects applications that decrypt CBC or ECB ciphertext with PKCS7 padding over multiple calls into the minimum documented output buffer. A remote user who supplies crafted ciphertext might crash the application or corrupt adjacent memory. Affected are all versions of AWS-LC before 5.7.0, AWS-LC-FIPS 4.x before 4.2.0, AWS-LC-FIPS 3.x before 3.6.0, and AWS-LC-FIPS 2.x before 2.0.18. To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to AWS-LC 5.7.0, AWS-LC-FIPS 4.2.0, or AWS-LC-FIPS 3.6.0. AWS-LC-FIPS 2.0.18 is also…

items.title: CVE-2026-60079
items.summary: Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache IoTDB. Authenticated REST clients can insert large payload to trigger heap-exhaustion DoS. This issue affects Apache IoTDB: from 0.13.0 through 2.0.11. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.12, which fixes the issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-60076
items.summary: Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache IoTDB. Unbounded in-memory materialization in REST fastLastQuery cache-hit path enables heap-exhaustion DoS. This issue affects Apache IoTDB: from 2.0.5 before 2.0.12. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.12, which fixes the issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-60078
items.summary: Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache IoTDB. Authenticated Grafana clients can bypass row-limit cap to trigger heap-exhaustion DoS. This issue affects Apache IoTDB: from 0.13.0 through 2.0.11. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.12, which fixes the issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-60077
items.summary: Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache IoTDB. Authenticated REST clients can bypass row-limit cap to triggerheap-exhaustion DoS. This issue affects Apache IoTDB: from 0.13.0 before 2.0.12. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.12, which fixes the issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-135155
items.summary: PodFetch 5.2.0 before 5.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Audiobookshelf-compatible POST /api/podcasts endpoint that allows authenticated low-privilege users to add podcasts by bypassing role and USER_PODCAST_LIMIT checks. Attackers with the plain user role can submit attacker-chosen feed URLs in media.metadata.feedUrl to force server-side fetching and episode downloads, consuming disk and bandwidth.

items.title: CVE-2026-135261
